node.title: Re^3: constant vector
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The 'Readonly' module uses the now-deprecated 'Internals' module to set/clear the scalar read-only flag.

Well, so does the core pragma [doc://constant], but it does seem like P5P might change the API in the future. For reference, [http://www.nntp.perl.org/group/perl.perl5.porters/2016/08/msg238709.html|here is the discussion] that led to the creation of [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/blob/HEAD:/lib/Internals.pod|Internals.pod].
